items.text: extra charge hai bill me
Mera postpaid bill jo 15 february ko aaya hai wo galat hai
Is bill me 1500 rupees extra charge dikh raha hai jo use nahi kiya maine
Maine dekha ki mera mobile se 700 rupees ka international call charge lagaya hai
Kya aap meri bill details check kar sakte hain mera customer ID hai 890 123 456
Mera phone number 90086 00405 hai aur bill me kuch unexplained charge dikh raha hai
Main 12 january se 12 february ka bill dekh raha tha aur bill kaafi zyada hai is baar
Kya aap please mujhe explain kar sakte hain ki 300 rupees ka extra charge kyun aya hai

items.context: Kya aap bata sakte hain ki kis din ka charge galat hai

items.text: Extra charges ke baare me mujhe clear karna hai
Maine apne postpaid account se notice kiya ki last bill jo 20 february ko aaya tha wo bilkul hi zyada tha aur usme 1200 rupees ka unexplained charge tha
Mera phone number 99321 56789 hai aur mera customer ID 456 789 123 hai maine yeh verify karna hai ki bill me extra charge kis wajah se lagaya gaya hai
Main complain karna chahta hu ki mera jan 2024 ka bill galat calculate hua hai kyunki maine international calls nahi ki jo extra 900 rupees charge dikh raha hai

items.context: Kya aap apne bill ki details mujhe verify kar ke bata sakte hain ki kis date ka charge galat hai
items.text: Mera bill galat hai mujhe lagta hai ki international call charges galat lagaye gaye hain bill me

items.context: Aap apna registered mobile number bata sakte hain please taki main aapka account check kar saku
items.text: January ke mahine ka bill 2900 ki jagah 3600 aaya hai aur maine us mahine itna use nahi kiya

items.context: Kya aap mujhe apna account number ya registered mobile number provide kar sakte hain

request.system:
You write realistic things that customers say to a voice agent on a phone call in India.
Write what the customer says out loud, as speech recognition would transcribe it:
natural spoken word order, fillers kept, no punctuation needed.
Each utterance is one complete customer turn: the customer has finished speaking
and is waiting for the agent to reply.
request.user:
Domain: telecom
Intent: bill_dispute - says a postpaid bill or charge is wrong
Language: Hindi-English code-mixed, entirely in Latin script (e.g. 'mera account se paise kat gaye but transfer nahi hua').
Style for this batch: with numbers (account and phone numbers, OTPs, amounts, dates) written as numerals, with long numbers spaced in groups the way people say them

Write exactly 24 different customer turns in these six groups:
- "short": exactly 3 turns of 1-4 words (for example 'haan ji', 'kal tak', 'theek hai'),
- "short_with_context": exactly 3 turns of 1-4 words, each with the agent's question before it,
- "medium": exactly 7 turns of 5-12 words,
- "medium_with_context": exactly 5 turns of 5-12 words, each with the agent's question before it,
- "long": exactly 3 turns of 13-30 words,
- "long_with_context": exactly 3 turns of 13-30 words, each with the agent's question before it.
In the *_with_context groups, "context" is the question the agent asked just before that turn.
Vary people, amounts, dates, names and places. Do not number them. Do not start two turns the same way.
Return JSON: {"short": [{"text": "..."}, ...], "short_with_context": [{"text": "...", "context": "..."}, ...],
"medium": [...], "medium_with_context": [...], "long": [...], "long_with_context": [...]}
Every turn and question must be in Latin script.
